summary: Iteration 129 - Payroll Management & Expense Management fully tested. All 33 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all components loading correctly, all data-testid selectors working, and full CRUD operations functional.

features: Returns period, total_staff, total_gross, total_adjustments, total_advances, grand_total, rows
Each row has staff_id, name, role, days_worked, daily_rate, gross, adjustments, advances, net
Uses ROLE_RATES: receptionist=50, housekeeper=80, maintenance=100, manager=120, admin=150
Defaults to current month when year/month not provided

endpoints: POST /api/payroll/runs/{property_id} - creates draft run with snapshot; 400 on duplicate year/month
POST /api/payroll/runs/{property_id}/{id}/mark-paid - sets status=paid, auto-marks linked advances as repaid (admin-only)
DELETE /api/payroll/runs/{property_id}/{id} - deletes draft only; 400 on paid

features: Deduction and tax types subtract in earnings calculation

endpoints: GET /api/expenses/categories/{property_id}?year=&month= - returns 9 default categories with spent/budget/usage_pct
features: 9 default categories: utilities, supplies, maintenance, marketing, salaries, rent, food, tech, other
Each category includes spent, budget, usage_pct

endpoints: POST /api/expenses/recurring/{property_id}/{id}/post - creates expense from template, advances next_due, increments total_posted
POST /api/expenses/recurring/{property_id}/run-due - posts all enabled+due templates in one call

features_verified: 5 KPI cards: Staff, Gross, Adjustments, Advances, Net Payable
4 tabs: Earned Salaries, Payroll Runs, Adjustments, Cash Advances
Earnings table with staff, role, days, rate, gross, adj, adv, net columns
Create Run button for current month
New Adjustment dialog with staff select, type select, amount input, reason textarea
New Advance dialog with staff select, amount input, reason textarea
Run actions: approve-{id}, pay-{id} buttons
Advance actions: approve-adv-{id} button
4 KPI cards: Total Spent, Transactions, Avg/Expense, Recurring
3 tabs: Expenses, Recurring, Categories & Budgets
Category filter pills with spending amounts
Expenses table with date, vendor, category, description, amount, method, actions
New Expense dialog with vendor, date, category, amount, payment method, reference, description, receipt URL, notes
New Recurring dialog with vendor, category, amount, frequency, next due, description, auto-post checkbox
9 budget category cards with icons, colors, spent/budget, usage bars
Budget dialog with amount input and save button
Run Due button (visible when due_count > 0)
Post Now button on due recurring items
Sidebar nav items present: Payroll, Expenses
Both nav items clickable and navigate to correct views

All endpoints properly protected with role-based authentication (admin/manager for most, any role for advance requests)
ROLE_RATES correctly implemented: receptionist=50, housekeeper=80, maintenance=100, manager=120, admin=150 GBP/day

Payroll run snapshot captures earnings at creation time
Mark-paid correctly auto-marks linked cash advances as repaid
Expense categories correctly return 9 defaults with spent/budget/usage_pct
Recurring post correctly advances next_due based on frequency
Run-due batch posts all enabled+due templates in one call
